name: Red Velvet
profile: Red Velvet is a 5 member girl group formed by SM Entertainment. They made their debut on August 1, 2014 with 4 members (Irene, Seulgi, Wendy and Joy) and the song Happiness. Their second song was Be Natural, a remake of an S.E.S song, featuring Taeyong, then a trainee and now member of NCT. In March 2015 they added another member, Yeri, and they released their first EP titled Ice Cream Cake. They released MVs for Ice Cream Cake and Automatic. In September 2015 Red Velvet released their first full album titled The Red, with Dumb Dumb as their title track, and in March 2016 their second EP titled The Velvet, with song One Of These Nights as the title track. Three more EPs followed: Russian Roulette in September 2016, Rookie in February 2017 and The Red Summer in July 2017 (with Red Flavor as the title track). In November 2017 they released Peek-A-Boo from the EP Perfect Velvet. In July 2020, Red Velvet – IRENE & SEULGI, the first sub-unit of Red Velvet will release their 1st mini album titled Monster.

name: QWER
profile: QWER is a four-member South Korean girl band formed through the QWER Project and managed by Tamago Production. The members are Chodan, Magenta, Hina and Siyeon, whose roles cover drums, bass, guitar, keyboards and vocals. The group debuted on October 18, 2023 with the single album Harmony from Discord and its lead track Discord. Their name comes from the Q, W, E and R keys used for abilities in online games, reflecting how the four members combine their different roles to create music. Their sound draws from pop rock, J-rock and anime-song influences. Their first EP, Manito, was released in April 2024 and included the single T.B.H, followed by the EP Algorithm's Blossom and its lead single My Name Is Malguem in September 2024.

name: ITZY
profile: ITZY is a five-member South Korean girl group formed by JYP Entertainment. The members are Yeji, Lia, Ryujin, Chaeryeong and Yuna. They debuted on February 12, 2019 with the single album It'z Different and its lead single Dalla Dalla. The group became known for energetic performances, a teen-crush style and songs centered on confidence, independence and self-love. Their early releases included Icy, Wannabe, Not Shy and In the Morning. In 2021 they released their first studio album, Crazy in Love, featuring Loco. Their 2022 EP Checkmate became their first million-selling release and reached the top ten of the Billboard 200. ITZY also expanded into Japan with singles including Voltage and Blah Blah Blah.

name: EXID
profile: EXID, short for Exceed in Dreaming, is a five-member South Korean girl group consisting of Solji, Elly, Hani, Hyelin and Jeonghwa. The group debuted on February 16, 2012 with the single Whoz That Girl. After an early lineup change, Solji and Hyelin joined the group in 2012. EXID achieved a major breakthrough in 2014 when a fan-recorded performance of Up & Down went viral, sending the song back up the charts and earning the group its first music-show wins. They followed that success with songs including Ah Yeah, Hot Pink, L.I.E and DDD, as well as the studio album Street. After focusing on individual and Japanese activities, the members reunited in 2022 for their tenth anniversary and released the single album X with the lead track Fire.
